title: Mid-Century Suburban House Front Porch, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white square snapshot capturing the front exterior of a mid-century suburban home. The architectural design features a gabled roofline, front porch steps, decorative support posts, and a front door with three diagonal glass panes characteristic of mid-century design. The house number 2735 is visible above the doorway. This image reflects the post-World War II boom in American residential housing and suburban expansion.
